name: browser-use
headline: whatsapp-cli: Integrate WhatsApp with Claude Code
short_description: Connects Claude to WhatsApp for automated messaging. Operations teams use it to handle customer inquiries, send notifications, and integrate WhatsApp into workflows. Works with Go-based systems and Claude agents.
author: vicentereig

sections.overview: The whatsapp-cli skill allows developers to integrate WhatsApp functionality directly into their Claude Code environment. This automation skill enables AI agents to send and receive messages through WhatsApp, thereby enhancing communication capabilities within applications. By leveraging this skill, teams can streamline interactions and automate notifications, making it a valuable addition for those looking to enhance their AI workflows. One of the key benefits of the whatsapp-cli skill is its potential to save time in communication processes. While the exact time savings are currently unknown, the ability to automate messaging can significantly reduce the manual effort required for updates, alerts, or customer interactions. This skill is particularly beneficial for developers and product managers who are focused on improving user engagement and operational efficiency. The whatsapp-cli skill is designed for intermediate users, making it suitable for developers and AI practitioners who have some experience with automation tools. It fits well into AI-first workflows by providing a seamless way to incorporate messaging capabilities into applications, allowing for real-time communication without the need for extensive manual input. For instance, a product manager could use this skill to automate customer feedback requests via WhatsApp, enhancing user experience while minimizing the workload on the team. Implementing the whatsapp-cli skill typically requires around 30 minutes, making it a relatively quick addition to your automation toolkit. While it currently has a medium GTM relevance and a modest number of GitHub stars, its potential for enhancing communication through AI automation is clear. As businesses increasingly adopt AI agents for various tasks, integrating WhatsApp capabilities can provide a competitive edge in customer engagement and workflow automation.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/vicentereig/whatsapp-cli`
sections.usage:
```
Connect to WhatsApp using the CLI and send a message to [PHONE_NUMBER] from [COMPANY_NAME] account. The message should be: '[MESSAGE_CONTENT]'. Ensure the message is delivered and confirm the status.
